image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small weasel (likely a stoat or short-tailed weasel in summer coat) peeking through tall green grass. The animal has a slender body with brown fur on its back and head, and white/cream fur on its chest and underside. Its head is triangular with a pointed snout, small dark eyes that appear slightly glossy/blue due to lighting, and small rounded ears. The foreground grass is out of focus, creating depth.
